import Mathlib
import PEqualNP.Defs

theorem PEqualNP.Outside.L_meta_253 :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : Fin n)
      (x : Fin n → Bool),
      decide (∃ u w : Fin n, G.Adj u w ∧
        Function.update x v false u = true ∧ Function.update x v false w = true) =
      decide (∃ u w : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ w ≠ v ∧ G.Adj u w ∧
        x u = true ∧ x w = true) := by
  intro n G _ v x
  have updated (u : Fin n) :
      Function.update x v false u = true ↔ u ≠ v ∧ x u = true := by
    by_cases h : u = v
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  rw [decide_eq_decide]
  simp_rw [updated]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, w, hadj, ⟨huv, hu⟩, ⟨hwv, hw⟩⟩
    exact ⟨u, w, huv, hwv, hadj, hu, hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, w, huv, hwv, hadj, hu, hw⟩
    exact ⟨u, w, hadj, ⟨huv, hu⟩, ⟨hwv, hw⟩⟩

import Mathlib
import PEqualNP.Defs

theorem PEqualNP.Outside.L_meta_727 : ∀ (n t : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : Fin n), (∃ S : Finset (Fin n), (∀ a b : Fin n, G.Adj a b → a ∈ S ∨ b ∈ S) ∧ S.card = t) → (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ c d : Fin n, G.Adj c d → c ∈ T ∨ d ∈ T) → t ≤ T.card) → t < (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G.Adj v u)).card → ∀ U : Finset (Fin n), (∀ e f : Fin n, G.Adj e f → e ∈ U ∨ f ∈ U) → U.card = t → v ∈ U := by
  intro n t G _ v _ _ hdeg U hU hUc
  by_contra hv
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G.Adj v u) ⊆ U := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hu
    rcases hU v u hu with h | h
    · exact absurd h hv
    · exact h
  have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  omega
